- list_progress_photos: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read only through tx.progress_photos().list_project_photos with context.project_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it filters viewer visibility or orders the result; visibility filtering and ordering belong to this function, not to persistence, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level photo method.

topics.topic: Canonical origin normalization for scheme and host case differences
questions: Must scheme- or host-case-only differences normalize to the same canonical origin, or must every textual difference in scheme or host produce a different canonical origin?

quotes: It MUST return the canonical origin: the lowercased scheme, the lowercased host, and the effective port, taking the explicit port when the value carries one and otherwise 443 for https and 80 for http.

The returned canonical origin MUST discriminate: two values differing in scheme, differing in host, differing by any additional host prefix, differing by any additional host suffix, or differing in effective port MUST each receive a different canonical origin.
judgement.why: Lowercasing requires scheme- or host-case-only variants to normalize identically, while the discrimination rule requires values differing in scheme or host to receive different canonical origins.
